description: Figure: measured Gpm1 active-site contacts to 3-PGA and residue identity at those positions across the Gpm2/Gpm3 clade
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
df=pd.read_csv("active_site_conservation.csv")
cols=[c for c in df.columns if c not in ("Gpm1_site","class","Gpm1")]
nice={"Gpm2_Scer":"Gpm2 S. cerevisiae","Gpm3_Scer":"Gpm3 S. cerevisiae","GpmA_Ecoli":"GpmA E. coli",
      "PGAM1_human":"PGAM1 human","BPGM_human":"BPGM human","Gpm3_Kmarxianus":"Gpm3 K. marxianus",
      "Gpm3_Zmellis":"Gpm3 Z. mellis","Gpm3_Kexigua":"Gpm3 M. exigua","Gpm3_Munispora":"Gpm3 M. unispora",
      "Gpm3_Mservazzii":"Gpm3 M. servazzii"}
order=["GpmA_Ecoli","PGAM1_human","BPGM_human","Gpm3_Scer","Gpm2_Scer","Gpm3_Kmarxianus","Gpm3_Zmellis",
       "Gpm3_Kexigua","Gpm3_Munispora","Gpm3_Mservazzii"]
d3pg={"Arg7":3.47,"His8":3.10,"Arg59":2.78,"Glu86":4.48,"His181":5.52,"Asn183":7.31,"Thr207":3.59,
      "Asn204":6.60,"Arg113":8.14,"Arg114":7.88}
Mat=np.zeros((len(df),len(order)))
for j,o in enumerate(order):
    for i in range(len(df)):
        a=df[o][i]; r=df["Gpm1"][i]
        Mat[i,j]= 2 if a==r else (1 if a in "AVLIM" and r in "AVLIM" else 0)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,7.5),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,3.2]})
ax=axes[0]
labs=[f"{s}" for s in df["Gpm1_site"]]
vals=[d3pg.get(s,np.nan) for s in df["Gpm1_site"]]
y=np.arange(len(df))
ax.barh(y,[v if not np.isnan(v) else 0 for v in vals],color="#4C72B0")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("min distance to bound 3-PGA in Gpm1 (PDB 1QHF), A",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Gpm1 active site, measured",fontsize=10)
ax.axvline(4.5,color="grey",ls="--",lw=0.8)
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    if np.isnan(v): ax.text(0.2,i,"contact via IHP site (1BQ3)",va="center",fontsize=7,color="#555555")

ax=axes[1]
cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#C44E52","#DD8452","#55A868"])
ax.imshow(Mat,cmap=cmap,aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=2)
for i in range(len(df)):
    for j,o in enumerate(order):
        ax.text(j,i,df[o][i],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,color="white",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_xticklabels([nice[o] for o in order],rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{s} ({c})" for s,c in zip(df['Gpm1_site'],df['class'])],fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(2.5,color="black",lw=2)
ax.set_title("Residue at each Gpm1 active-site position\ngreen = identical to Gpm1, orange = conservative aliphatic, red = substituted",fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("Gpm1 active-site positions scored across the Gpm2/Gpm3 clade of Saccharomycetaceae",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print(pd.DataFrame(Mat,index=df["Gpm1_site"],columns=order).to_string())
print("\nretained in Gpm3_Scer:", int((Mat[:,order.index('Gpm3_Scer')]==2).sum()), "/", len(df))
